title.cn: Device Manager V2 设备管理开发包

summary.cn: 在头显应用中调用网络、应用、文件、电源与系统播放器等设备能力。
summary.en: Call networking, application, storage, power and system-player functions from a headset app.

cn: 准备支持设备及其 DeviceManagerService。
先确定 Android 原生或 Unity 接入方式；按目标接口核对权限。
en: Use a supported headset with DeviceManagerService.
Choose Android or Unity integration and check the permissions of the required API.

cn.title: 选择接入方式
cn.body: Android 原生项目导入 AIDL；Unity 项目导入对应 unitypackage。两种方式调用同一设备服务。

cn.title: 配置接口权限
cn.body: NORMAL 接口无需额外授权；更高权限需要按文档配置应用版本 Key 或渠道固件 Key。

cn.title: 绑定服务并注册回调
cn.body: 连接 DeviceManagerService，集中注册结果与事件监听，避免后注册的监听器覆盖已有处理。

cn.title: 提交一项任务
cn.body: 从具体接口页确认分类、名称、参数和权限，提交后保留 jobID。受理成功不等于业务完成。

cn.title: 处理结果和持续事件
cn.body: 用 jobID 关联异步结果；电池、扫描等持续变化按对应事件说明订阅和释放。

en.title: Choose an integration
en.body: Import AIDL for Android, or the corresponding unitypackage for Unity. Both access the same device service.

en.title: Configure permissions
en.body: NORMAL APIs need no additional authorization. Higher levels require the documented application-version or firmware-channel key.

en.title: Bind the service and listeners
en.body: Connect to DeviceManagerService and centralize result and event listeners so later registrations do not replace existing handlers.

en.title: Submit one job
en.body: Read the API category, name, parameters and permissions, then retain the returned jobID. Acceptance does not mean completion.

en.title: Handle results and events
en.body: Match asynchronous results by jobID. Subscribe to and release ongoing battery or scan events as documented.

cn: 没有结果时先检查服务绑定、权限和监听器是否被覆盖。
按具体 API 的版本、参数、结果和事件说明排查，不能只看资源页型号。
en: Check service binding, permissions and overwritten listeners when results are missing.
Check the individual API version, parameters, result and events; the model list alone is insufficient.

caution.cn: 这是设备内服务接口，不是远程控制台；具体固件和接口权限决定可用能力。
caution.en: This is an on-device service interface, not a remote console. Firmware and API permissions determine availability.

summary.cn: 开发一个控制端，在局域网内管理多台头显，并与头显应用交换消息。
summary.en: Build a controller for multiple headsets on a local network and exchange messages with headset apps.

kind.cn: 远程控制协议与开发库

cn: 确认设备具备 RDC 服务，按功能检查播放器等附加服务。
准备局域网；自动发现还要求同一广播域并允许广播。
en: Confirm the RDC service and any additional services required by the selected features.
Prepare a LAN; automatic discovery also requires the same broadcast domain and permitted broadcasts.

cn.title: 选择控制端路线
cn.body: Windows 64 位 .NET 7 项目可使用封装库；其他平台或需要直接接协议时阅读 TCP 消息协议。

cn.title: 核对设备端服务
cn.body: 检查 RDC、播放器及所需开机自启服务；缺少服务不能靠安装电脑端库解决。

cn.title: 设置连接地址
cn.body: 在设备端设置服务器 IP 和端口，或使用自动发现。开启自动发现后手填地址失效。

cn.title: 启动服务端并识别设备
cn.body: 注册连接及消息回调，启动监听，等待设备连接并上报 SN 后再选择控制对象。

cn.title: 验证目标功能
cn.body: 先核对单设备控制结果，再扩展多设备。分发内容时另外提供设备可访问的 HTTP/HTTPS 文件地址。

en.title: Choose a controller route
en.body: Use the .NET 7 Win64 library where appropriate, or implement the TCP protocol for other platforms or direct protocol access.

en.title: Check headset services
en.body: Verify RDC, the player and any required startup service. Installing a PC library does not add missing headset services.

en.title: Configure the connection
en.body: Set the server IP and port on the headset, or use automatic discovery. Automatic discovery overrides the manually entered address.

en.title: Start the server and identify clients
en.body: Register connection and message callbacks, start listening, and select a client after it connects and reports its serial number.

en.title: Verify the required feature
en.body: Check one device before scaling out. Content distribution additionally requires HTTP/HTTPS file URLs accessible to each headset.

cn: 发现失败时检查广播域、路由器广播设置和设备配置。
控制命令发送成功不代表播放、投屏或下载已经完成，需读取对应状态。
en: If discovery fails, check the broadcast domain, router settings and headset configuration.
A sent command does not confirm playback, casting or download completion; inspect the relevant status.

caution.cn: RDC 发送内容清单，不代理文件；下载需要独立 HTTP 服务。库默认连接数不是性能保证。
caution.en: RDC sends content manifests and does not proxy files. Downloads require a separate HTTP service. Library defaults are not performance guarantees.

title.cn: AIO GO 设备维护工具

summary.cn: 通过电脑查看一体机信息，安装应用并执行设备维护操作。
summary.en: Inspect headset information, install applications and perform maintenance from a PC.

cn: 准备 Windows 10 电脑、支持头显及可传数据的 USB 线；这是官方操作手册给出的环境。
下载并解压官方安装包。
en: Prepare a Windows 10 PC, a supported headset and a USB data cable, as specified in the official guide.
Download and extract the official package.

cn.title: 安装工具
cn.body: 运行安装包内 Setup.exe，完成 AIO GO 安装。

cn.title: 通过 USB 连接头显
cn.body: 开启头显并连接电脑，在工具中检查是否识别到设备。

cn.title: 核对设备信息
cn.body: 先核对设备序列号和固件版本，确认当前操作对象。

cn.title: 选择所需操作
cn.body: 根据任务选择应用安装、文件管理、截图、录屏或日志等功能；固件维护使用与设备匹配的文件。

en.title: Install the tool
en.body: Run Setup.exe from the package to install AIO GO.

en.title: Connect over USB
en.body: Power on the headset, connect it to the PC and check that the tool recognizes it.

en.title: Check device information
en.body: Check the serial number and firmware version to confirm the selected device.

en.title: Choose the required operation
en.body: Select app installation, file management, screenshots, recording or logs. Use device-matched files for firmware maintenance.

cn: 无法看到设备存储时，可查阅 USB 文件传输排障；它不等同于 ADB 授权排障。
现有资料未覆盖所有驱动、无线连接和固件兼容条件。
定制设备名称无法识别时，按官方 PDF 的 Device.config 说明处理。
en: Use the USB file-access guide when storage is unavailable; it is not an ADB authorization guide.
Available documentation does not establish every driver, wireless or firmware compatibility requirement.
For unrecognized custom device names, follow the Device.config instructions in the official PDF.

caution.cn: AIO GO 与 AIO GO 2 的支持型号不同，不能仅按名称数字替换；恢复出厂等操作需先了解其影响。
caution.en: AIO GO and AIO GO 2 support different model sets. Do not replace one solely because of its name; understand the effects of maintenance operations such as factory reset.

title.cn: AIO GO 2 设备操作工具

summary.cn: 免安装的 Windows 工具，用于画面镜像、录屏、文件传输和应用安装。
summary.en: A portable Windows utility for mirroring, recording, transferring files and installing apps.

cn: 使用 P1 Max 或 P2，准备 Windows 电脑和 USB 数据连接。
工具已集成 ADB 与 Scrcpy；不要把额外安装它们当作已证实的必需步骤。
en: Use a P1 Max or P2 with a Windows PC and a USB data connection.
ADB and Scrcpy are bundled; separate installation is not a documented prerequisite.

cn.title: 解压并运行
cn.body: 下载官方压缩包，解压后双击运行，无需安装。

cn.title: 连接并识别设备
cn.body: 开启头显并通过 USB 连接，等待工具读取型号、电量、SN 和系统信息。

cn.title: 查看或记录画面
cn.body: 按任务选择画面镜像、录屏、截图或日志采集。现有资料未说明全部输出位置。

cn.title: 传输文件或安装应用
cn.body: 使用文件区域传输内容；APK 区域会在传输后安装应用，先确认所选文件。

en.title: Extract and run
en.body: Download and extract the official package, then double-click to run without installation.

en.title: Connect and identify the headset
en.body: Power on the headset, connect it over USB and wait for model, battery, serial and system information.

en.title: View or record the screen
en.body: Choose mirroring, recording, screenshots or log capture. Documentation does not establish all output locations.

en.title: Transfer content or install apps
en.body: Transfer content through the file area. The APK area installs apps after transfer, so verify the selected file first.

cn: 未识别设备时先确认头显开机和 USB 数据连接。
无线开关在原界面可见，但现有资料不足以提供完整无线配对教程。
en: If no device is detected, check headset power and the USB data connection.
A wireless switch is visible, but available sources do not provide a complete pairing procedure.

caution.cn: 文件名 update.zip 在工具中有固件更新含义，不应当普通内容随意上传；固件适配需另行核对。
caution.en: The filename update.zip triggers firmware-related behavior and should not be uploaded as ordinary content. Verify firmware compatibility separately.

summary.cn: 把头显实时画面显示到兼容接收设备，按接收端能力选择投屏方式。
summary.en: Display the live headset screen on a compatible receiver using the appropriate casting method.

kind.cn: 投屏操作与接收端应用

cn: 先确认接收端使用 Miracast 还是 DPVR 无线投屏。
DPVR 无线投屏要求 Android 4.4+ 电视或平板、接收应用及相同 Wi-Fi。
en: Choose between Miracast and DPVR wireless casting based on the receiver.
DPVR wireless casting requires an Android 4.4+ TV or tablet, the receiver app and the same Wi-Fi network.

cn.title: 打开头显投屏设置
cn.body: 在头显主界面进入快捷设置，选择投屏。

cn.title: 选择接收方式
cn.body: 接收设备支持 Miracast 时选 Android 投屏；使用 DPVR 接收应用时选无线投屏。

cn.title: 完成所选分支
cn.body: Miracast：启用系统投屏并选择目标。DPVR 无线：接收端安装并打开 TV_ScreenPlayer.apk，连接相同 Wi-Fi，点击开始投屏。

en.title: Open casting settings
en.body: Open Quick Settings on the headset and select casting.

en.title: Choose the receiver method
en.body: Choose Android casting for a Miracast receiver, or wireless casting for the DPVR receiver app.

en.title: Complete the selected branch
en.body: Miracast: enable system casting and select the receiver. DPVR wireless: install and open TV_ScreenPlayer.apk on the receiver, use the same Wi-Fi and start casting.

cn: 无线方式先查接收应用是否打开、设备是否处于相同 Wi-Fi。
Miracast 接收端需支持该协议；不能把所有 Android 电视当作无条件兼容。
en: For wireless casting, check that the receiver app is open and both devices use the same Wi-Fi.
Miracast receivers must support the protocol; Android TV alone does not establish compatibility.

caution.cn: 两种方式是分支，不需要顺次执行；本指南不承诺音频、延迟或多接收端效果。
caution.en: These are alternative routes, not consecutive steps. This guide does not establish audio, latency or multi-receiver behavior.

summary.cn: 在电脑上把 MP4 制作为带设备 SN 和有效期授权的播放文件。
summary.en: Prepare MP4 content on a PC with headset serial-number and expiry-date authorization.

cn: 准备 MP4、目标头显 SN、授权截止日期和足够磁盘空间。
GUI 使用 Windows 10/11 x64；妥善保存本地密钥、管理员密码和管理数据。
en: Prepare MP4 files, headset serial numbers, expiry dates and sufficient disk space.
The GUI requires Windows 10/11 x64. Retain local keys, the admin password and management data.

cn.title: 选择图形界面或批处理
cn.body: 日常内容与设备清单管理使用 GUI；配置驱动的自动化流程使用 CLI。

cn.title: 完成密钥和设备准备
cn.body: GUI 首次设置密钥与管理员密码，再录入或导入 SN；CLI 按对应手册填写 sn.txt 和 config.ini。

cn.title: 设置期限并加密
cn.body: GUI 选择 MP4、有效日期和授权设备后加密；CLI 将 MP4 放入 input_video，运行 encrypt.bat。

cn.title: 交付完整文件组
cn.body: 从输出目录取得同名 .mp4、.dpve1、.dpvei，放到目标头显内部存储同一目录，使用支持的播放器验证。

cn.title: 按需更新授权
cn.body: CLI 的授权更新流程使用原 vei_key 更新 .dpvei，再覆盖设备旧授权；GUI 的保存并加密会重新加密并覆盖产物。

en.title: Choose GUI or batch processing
en.body: Use the GUI for day-to-day content and device lists, or the CLI for configuration-driven automation.

en.title: Prepare keys and devices
en.body: In the GUI, configure keys and the admin password before adding serial numbers. For the CLI, prepare sn.txt and config.ini as documented.

en.title: Set authorization and encrypt
en.body: Select the MP4, expiry date and devices in the GUI, or put MP4 files in input_video and run encrypt.bat for the CLI.

en.title: Deploy the complete file set
en.body: Place matching .mp4, .dpve1 and .dpvei files in the same internal-storage directory on the target headset and verify playback with a supported player.

en.title: Update authorization when needed
en.body: The CLI authorization workflow updates .dpvei using the original vei_key. Replace the old authorization file. GUI Save & Encrypt re-encrypts and overwrites output.

cn: 失败先检查 MP4 封装、磁盘空间、同名输出和所选 SN。
授权更新需要原 VEI_KEY；GUI 密钥保存后不可修改或恢复。
en: Check MP4 format, free space, duplicate output names and selected serial numbers.
Authorization updates require the original VEI_KEY. Saved GUI keys cannot be changed or recovered.

caution.cn: 加密方案 V3 与 GUI 软件版本 2.0.0 是不同维度。GUI 与 CLI 的字段约束和默认值不同，勿混用；当前资料不足以承诺任意平台的 SN 验证行为。
caution.en: Encryption V3 and GUI version 2.0.0 describe different components. GUI and CLI constraints and defaults differ. Sources do not establish serial-number enforcement on every platform.

summary.cn: 用 JSON 指定自动播放的视频、画面格式、摘戴行为和播放菜单。
summary.en: Use JSON to configure the startup video, projection format, headset-wear behavior and player controls.

cn: 先把视频部署到设备并确认绝对路径。
确认视频的平面、全景、立体等画面格式。
en: Deploy the video to the headset and confirm its absolute path.
Identify its flat, panoramic and stereoscopic layout.

cn.title: 修改视频路径和格式
cn.body: 在 AutoPlayDisposition.json 中填写 videoPath，并按视频实际布局选择 videoModel。

cn.title: 选择播放体验
cn.body: 设置自动播放、常亮或摘下熄屏、重播或续播，以及是否显示菜单。lockView 控制跟随头部或固定空间。

cn.title: 放置配置文件
cn.body: 在设备共享存储根目录创建 AutoVideoPlay 文件夹，将 JSON 放入其中。

cn.title: 启动播放器核对
cn.body: 播放器启动时读取配置；检查路径、画面格式、摘戴和菜单是否符合所选设置。

en.title: Set the path and video format
en.body: Set videoPath in AutoPlayDisposition.json and choose videoModel to match the actual layout.

en.title: Choose playback behavior
en.body: Configure autoplay, display-on or headset-removal behavior, restart or resume, and visible controls. lockView selects head-following or world-fixed placement.

en.title: Place the configuration
en.body: Create AutoVideoPlay at the root of shared storage and place the JSON file inside.

en.title: Start the player and verify
en.body: The player reads the file at startup. Check the path, projection, headset-removal behavior and controls.

cn: 未播放时先核对文件名、AutoVideoPlay 位置和视频绝对路径。
distance 仅用于平面模式 0、1、4；范围的中英原文不一致，需按设备确认。
en: If playback does not start, check the filename, AutoVideoPlay location and absolute video path.
distance only applies to flat modes 0, 1 and 4. Published range descriptions differ by language and need device verification.

caution.cn: 网页和下载样例的 lockView 值不同，均为合法配置示例，不是唯一默认值；此文件不负责生成视频授权。
caution.en: The web and downloadable examples use different valid lockView values, not a single mandatory default. This file does not generate video authorization.

summary.cn: 在头显上读取任务清单，批量安装应用、解压资源或复制文件。
summary.en: Read a task list on the headset to install apps, unpack resources and copy files.

cn: 在支持头显安装 CopyTool.apk。
准备 TF 卡、配置引用的文件以及设备可用存储空间。
en: Install CopyTool.apk on a supported headset.
Prepare a TF card, the referenced source files and sufficient headset storage.

cn.title: 定义任务清单
cn.body: 创建 copy_config.json 数组，按目的选择 APK、ZIP_UNPACK、FILE、OBB、LANGUAGE_PACKAGE 或 OTA_PACKAGE。

cn.title: 准备来源和目标
cn.body: 填写 source、dist 和可选 name；${EXT_SD} 表示 TF 卡根目录，APK 任务忽略 dist。

cn.title: 放置配置与内容
cn.body: 把配置放在 TF 卡根目录，再按 source 路径放置待安装、复制或解压的内容。

cn.title: 执行并检查任务
cn.body: 插卡后打开工具，自动加载并执行。检查进度、成功与失败计数、日志和后续队列。

cn.title: 按需清理临时缓存
cn.body: TF 卡上的 APK 和 ZIP 会先复制到本机临时目录；在后续队列区域按需清除缓存。

en.title: Define the task list
en.body: Create a copy_config.json array using APK, ZIP_UNPACK, FILE, OBB, LANGUAGE_PACKAGE or OTA_PACKAGE as required.

en.title: Set sources and destinations
en.body: Set source, dist and optional name. ${EXT_SD} means the TF card root; APK tasks ignore dist.

en.title: Place the configuration and content
en.body: Put the configuration at the TF card root and place each source file at its configured path.

en.title: Run and inspect the tasks
en.body: Insert the card and open the tool to load and execute tasks. Inspect progress, success and failure counts, logs and the post queue.

en.title: Clear temporary data as needed
en.body: APK and ZIP files from the card are first copied to local temporary storage. Clear the cache from the post-queue area when appropriate.

cn: 找不到源文件时检查 ${EXT_SD} 与卡内实际目录。
安装或解压失败时查看日志及本机空间，而不只检查目标目录。
en: Check ${EXT_SD} and the actual card layout when a source is missing.
For installation or extraction failures, inspect logs and local free space as well as the destination.

caution.cn: 此工具不是 TF 卡克隆软件。OTA_PACKAGE 只复制升级包，不会触发固件升级。
caution.en: This is not a TF-card cloning tool. OTA_PACKAGE copies an update package but does not start a firmware upgrade.

summary.cn: 在自己的 Unity 应用中显示视频，并接入播放、暂停和进度控制。
summary.en: Display video in your own Unity application with playback, pause and progress controls.

cn: 关闭 Multithreaded Rendering。
DPVR Unity SDK 0.8.1 不启用 Use SinglePass；OpenXR 使用 Multi-pass。
按指南检查 IL2CPP 与 64 位架构设置。
en: Disable Multithreaded Rendering.
Do not enable Use SinglePass with DPVR Unity SDK 0.8.1; use Multi-pass with OpenXR.
Check IL2CPP and 64-bit architecture settings against the guide.

cn.title: 导入当前插件包
cn.body: 解压 PlayerPlugin.zip，导入当前实际文件 Player20260904.unitypackage。

cn.title: 先跑通自动播放
cn.body: 使用自动播放示例，勾选 AutoPlay，设置 MediaUrl，并把显示载体赋给 VOuts。

cn.title: 匹配显示载体与材质
cn.body: Plane 使用 DPVR/PlainTextureYUV；RawImage 使用 DPVR/YUVTexture，按载体绑定对应材质。

cn.title: 需要交互时改用脚本控制
cn.body: 关闭自动播放，引用 IjkPlayer、媒体地址与载体；设置 VOuts 后调用 Play，并处理准备完成回调。

cn.title: 接入播放状态
cn.body: 使用 Duration、Current 显示状态，用 Pause、Resume、Seek 控制。时间单位未在简短指南中明确。

en.title: Import the current package
en.body: Extract PlayerPlugin.zip and import its current file, Player20260904.unitypackage.

en.title: Start with automatic playback
en.body: Use the automatic example, enable AutoPlay, set MediaUrl and assign display targets to VOuts.

en.title: Match targets and materials
en.body: Use DPVR/PlainTextureYUV for a Plane and DPVR/YUVTexture for a RawImage, with the corresponding materials.

en.title: Use scripted control when needed
en.body: Disable automatic playback and reference IjkPlayer, the media URI and targets. Set VOuts before calling Play and handle the prepared callback.

en.title: Connect playback state
en.body: Use Duration and Current for state, and Pause, Resume and Seek for control. The short guide does not establish the time units.

cn: 无画面先检查渲染模式、载体、材质和媒体地址。
解密播放虽在资源页列为能力，但指南不足以提供完整 V3 密钥与 URI 接入示例。
en: If no picture appears, check rendering mode, targets, materials and the media URI.
Decryption is listed as a feature, but the guide does not provide a complete V3 key and URI integration example.

caution.cn: 这是自有应用内播放器，不是系统播放器配置或投屏接收应用；当前未执行 Unity 或头显实测。
caution.en: This embeds playback in your app; it is not a system-player configuration or casting receiver. No Unity or headset execution test is claimed.

summary.cn: 在支持相机的一体机上接入预览与手势回调，再映射到自己的场景交互。
summary.en: Integrate camera preview and gesture callbacks on the supported headset, then map results to scene interactions.

cn: 仅按官网适配 P1 Pro 4K Camera，不能省略 Camera 型号限定。
安装 Unity Android Build Support，切换 Android 平台，开启真机 USB 调试。
授予相机权限并关闭 Multithreaded Rendering。
en: Use the listed P1 Pro 4K Camera model; the Camera qualification matters.
Install Unity Android Build Support, switch to Android and enable USB debugging on the headset.
Grant camera permission and disable Multithreaded Rendering.

cn.title: 导入完整插件
cn.body: 从 GestureDemoPlugin.zip 导入 Gesture.unitypackage。当前包 AAR 实际位于 Assets/Plugins/Android，与旧手册路径不同。

cn.title: 在真机运行示例
cn.body: 打开 Assets/GestureSdk/Scenes/SampleScene.unity，连接设备并 Build And Run；编辑器不能替代 Android Camera/AAR 链路。

cn.title: 确认预览与四种交互
cn.body: 检查相机画面：V_SIGN 激活并定位球体一次，OPEN_PALM 放大，FIST 缩小，THUMBS_UP 换色。

cn.title: 接入自己的场景
cn.body: 让 CameraManager 引用 RawImage；让 GestureTest 引用相机管理器、目标物体、预览 RectTransform 和渲染相机。

cn.title: 保留稳定参数再调整
cn.body: 先用 tickFps=5、numHands=1、CCW_90、LETTERBOX、AUTO；位置先做 X 镜像，深度在相机空间计算。

en.title: Import the complete plug-in
en.body: Import Gesture.unitypackage from GestureDemoPlugin.zip. The current AAR files are in Assets/Plugins/Android, unlike the old manual path.

en.title: Run the sample on a device
en.body: Open Assets/GestureSdk/Scenes/SampleScene.unity and Build And Run on the headset. The editor cannot replace the Android Camera/AAR pipeline.

en.title: Check preview and four interactions
en.body: Verify the preview: V_SIGN activates and positions the sphere once; OPEN_PALM enlarges it, FIST shrinks it and THUMBS_UP changes its color.

en.title: Integrate your own scene
en.body: Assign the RawImage to CameraManager. Bind GestureTest to the camera manager, target object, preview RectTransform and rendering camera.

en.title: Keep stable settings before tuning
en.body: Start with tickFps=5, numHands=1, CCW_90, LETTERBOX and AUTO. Apply horizontal mirroring and compute depth in camera space.

cn: 无画面：检查真机、AAR、相机权限和多线程渲染设置。
有画面无手势：检查初始化、参数与连续 seq 日志。
位置错位：检查预览对象、镜像补偿、渲染相机和深度值。
en: No preview: check the device, AAR dependencies, camera permission and multithreaded-rendering setting.
Preview without gestures: check initialization, parameters and continuous seq logs.
Incorrect position: check the preview reference, mirroring, rendering camera and depth offset.

caution.cn: 示例是手势分类与球体交互，不代表完整三维手骨骼追踪；关闭多线程渲染来自当前插件内入门说明。
caution.en: The sample demonstrates gesture classification and sphere interaction, not a complete 3D hand-skeleton system. The current bundled beginner guide explicitly requires disabling multithreaded rendering.
